title: An Extern top performer audits Ben & Jerry's with the four lenses — 'I initially rated its governance too generously'
summary: Wiky placed in the top 10% of the Corporate Strategy Externship that Eric mentors, where participants score real companies against Mission Drive, Financial Gravity, Governance and Mission Transmission. The dispute over Ben & Jerry's independent board made him revise his own scoring.
blockquote: My focus was Ben & Jerry’s, where I initially rated its governance too generously. The ongoing dispute surrounding its independent board highlighted an important lesson: safeguards only work when backed by genuine authority and independence.
